notes.title: Anime Friends Demo AMA at Steam Fest
notes.notes:
Greetings Anime Friends Fans,

We are excited to announce that we will be hosting another live stream event on Thursday - 09 Feb 2023 at 3PM CEST TIME, during the Steam Festival! During this live stream, our team will showcase the latest updates and features of our upcoming life sim game with flying dragons and a farming system.

In addition to the live stream, we also invite all of you to play and test the demo version of our game. This is a great opportunity for you to experience the world of Anime Friends and get a taste of what's to come.

Join us on Thursday to learn more about the game, meet new friends, and have some fun. We can't wait to share this exciting journey with all of you.

See you there!

Best regards,
The Anime Friends Team.

notes.title: Anime Friends - Demo on Steam Fest 2023!
notes.notes:
[b]Attention all anime fans![/b] 
We are thrilled to announce that the highly anticipated "Anime Friends" Demo will be going live during the Winter Festival on Steam in 2023. Mark your calendars for Monday, Feb 06th at 10 PM CEST time. This is a not-to-be-missed opportunity to experience the world of "Anime Friends" first-hand.

Don't forget to join us and download the demo of the game. We can't wait for you to dive into the exciting world of "Anime Friends" and see all the hard work and dedication that went into creating this one-of-a-kind gaming experience.

So gather your friends, schedule your time, and get ready to experience the world of "Anime Friends" like never before. We can't wait to see you there!

notes.title: Join the Playtests for Anime Friends - the Exciting New Life Sim Game
notes.notes:
Hi

We are excited to announce that playtests for our upcoming game, Anime Friends, are now open! This life sim game features flying dragons and a farming system, and offers players the chance to meet new friends, start their own farm, ride on dragons and embark on new adventures on flying islands in the world of Anime Friends.

In Anime Friends, players will be able to explore a new sim world, filled with unique characters and breathtaking landscapes. The game promises to be a fun and engaging experience for players of all ages.

We are looking for players to help us test the game and provide feedback on their experience. If you're interested in joining the playtests, sign up at our Steam Page

Don't miss out on this opportunity to be a part of the development of this exciting new game! We can't wait to see you in the world of Anime Friends.

Best regards
Your Anime Friends
